title: 第514章 蓬莱岛
slug: 昆仑山修仙下山后我无敌了
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

云峰直接召唤出来了一把巨大的飞行巨剑，让自己和二师姐踩在剑刃上。

至于浑天大圣，他的飞行法器很是特别，竟然是一朵云，一朵五颜六色的云彩。

“主人，这是俺的筋斗云，飞行速度可以达到每小时十万八千里。”

浑天大圣站在了筋斗云上笑嘻嘻地解释道，眼里满是自豪，因为浑天大圣的飞行速度是最快的，就算大师兄都飞不过他。

“好了，带路吧。”

云雪点头，“那好，就天字二号吧。”这样最好了，分开住自己也不放心，大通铺还太挤。虽然能多花几个钱，但是能安全一些。

“胜大哥！！”棽棽也一下认出了路胜，顿时满面惊喜的几步走近，狠狠给了他一个拥抱。

“紫烟，他不会有事吧？”朱兴学虽然很相信紫烟不会真正伤害他，但是还是未免有些担心，毕竟若是市长公子出事，他也会吃不了兜着走的。

所以说，既然做了爹妈，可得给自家宝贝做个好榜样，不能随心所欲地胡来了。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Yunfeng directly summoned a huge flying sword, letting himself and the second senior sister step on the blade.

As for the Great Sage Hun Tian, ​​his flying magic weapon is very special. It is actually a cloud, a colorful cloud.

"Master, this is my somersault cloud. It can fly at a speed of one hundred and eight thousand miles per hour."

The Great Sage Huntian stood on the somersault cloud and explained with a smile, his eyes full of pride, because the Great Sage Huntian has the fastest flying speed, and even the senior brother cannot fly him.

"Okay, lead the way."

Yun Xue nodded, "Okay, let's take Tianzi No. 2." This is the best. She doesn't feel comfortable living separately. Datong Shop is still too crowded.Although it costs a little more, it is safer.

"Brother Sheng!!" Yan Yan also recognized Lu Sheng at once, and immediately took a few steps closer with surprise on his face, and gave him a hug.

"Zi Yan, will he be okay?" Although Zhu Xingxue believed that Zi Yan would not really hurt him, he was still a little worried. After all, if something happened to the mayor's son, he would not be able to bear the consequences.

So, now that you are a parent, you have to set a good example for your baby, and you can't do whatever you want.
